text:
sara: spotted plaintext token in legacy-svc logs forwarded to partner (s3-ingest). token looks like `ya29.xxxxx`. Not high-volume but likely long-lived SA key. Opening incident.

tom: On it. I'll revoke the key and flip deployment to Workload Identity short-lived tokens.

sec-oncall: Triage steps: 1) revoke key in GCP, 2) revoke any Vault leases tied to that secret, 3) temporary IAM deny on svc account to stop key creation.

vault-bot: Vault audit: read infra/legacy/ingest -> principal=deploy-runner at 2026-03-20T11:05:02Z

ana: (ana) I can rewrap any KMS blobs if we find wrapped tokens. Send ciphertext ids.

ops: Applied IAM deny: policy-id deny-20260324-01. Also disabled user-managed keys for svc-legacy-ingest.

tom: Revoke output: `Deleted key [KEY-zzzyyxx].` Also set env blank in deploy: `kubectl -n legacy set env deploy/ingest TOKEN=""`

sec-oncall: Vault check: `vault kv get -mount=secret legacy/ingest` -> found secret with lease=lease-23. Revoking `vault lease revoke lease-23` now.

sara: Copying log snippet to ticket: `2026-03-24T10:58:33Z INFO forward: payload url=https://partner/hooks token=ya29.xxxxx svc=svc-legacy-ingest key=KEY-zzzyyxx`

ana: No ciphertext found in payloads. Still rewrap not needed. Will follow up if anything appears.

tom: Canary deployed workload identity (10%). No auth errors. Will go to 100% in 30m.

sec-oncall: Running audit for 30d for accesses to `legacy/*` and partner endpoints. Posting CSV to secure bucket.

ops: Created ticket INFRA-4102 to scan partner logs for plaintext tokens and to automate deny rule on any detected long-lived keys.

sara: Action items: tom revoke+rollout (owner), ops policy hold (owner), ana re-eval if ciphertexts found (owner), sec-oncall audit export (owner). Containment within 1h, full migration 6h. Postmortem tonight.

tom: All done - rollout complete, revoke evidence attached to INFRA-4102.

sara: Closing containment. Will kick off rotation sweep across connectors and schedule runbook update. :white_check_mark:
